title: CHED-P Transport to Port of Entry — POE list for Northern Ireland traders
spec: notification/ched-p/ched-p-poe-validation.spec.ts:38 › CHED-P Transport to Port of Entry — POE list per country of origin › should show the expected POE list for Northern Ireland traders
outcome: Creates a CHED-P (POAO) notification for a Northern Ireland trader (country of origin GB-NIR), fills commodity/purpose/risk pages, opens the Transport to the port of entry page, and asserts the Port of entry dropdown contains all real POEs plus all dummy POEs including GBSCOT (SCOTLAND-OTHER) for NI traders.
